results.title: Dragon Fury 3
results.overview: Deep within a high-security government bunker, an ancient nightmare has broken loose. This time, there’s nowhere to run. A daring break-in at a classified research facility quickly turns into a bloodbath when a group of intruders discovers they aren't alone. Instead of the secrets they came for, they find themselves hunted by genetically engineered, apex predators: lethal dragons with a taste for human prey. Trapped between a tactical lockdown and the jaws of prehistoric monsters, the group must fight through dark corridors and deadly traps. It’s a race against time to escape before the facility is purged - or the dragons finish their feast.

results.title: A Woman's Life
results.overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

results.title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
results.original_title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
results.overview: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...

results.title: Company
results.overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 11
results.overview: The eleventh night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 20, 2026, at Aore Nagaoka in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan and featured two semi-final matches.

results.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 2
results.overview: The second night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 9, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Dreamboat
results.overview: When an underground musician’s unconventional romance with her beloved pillow is violently cut short by her mother, she spirals into a delirious odyssey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires, and grip on reality are tested by an enigmatic homeless poet. As she searches for love and connection in an increasingly alienating city, the abandoned pillow begins to develop a will of its own.

results.title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
results.overview: Seven years after her Grammy Award-winning “Amidst the Chaos”, Sara Bareilles reunites with her closest collaborators to record a new album. What emerges is an intimate, cinematic process that lays bare the musician's deep connections and inspirations in  Josh Alexander's moving music documentary.

results.title: Running Man Vietnam 2026: The Lord Of Time
results.original_title: Running Man Việt Nam 2026 : Chúa Tể Thời Gian
results.overview: Humanity races endlessly, dreaming of becoming the Lord of Time—believing that only by mastering time can they find true freedom in a relentless world. Yet even the divine beasts who govern the flow of time are trapped by the very power they possess, as their greatest gift has become an inescapable burden. Now, a breathtaking battle of supernatural abilities is about to unfold. But does the crown of the Lord of Time truly exist?

results.title: 1998, l'été de nos 18 ans
results.overview: It was the summer of Les Bleus' victory. A memorable summer. The last one before the explosion of the Internet and cell phones. A turning point for an entire country and for a high school girl from the Vosges on the verge of leaving her teenage years behind: Maria Pourchet. Now a writer, she recounts this era, etched in our memories, through her words and archival materials.

results.title: Tiliche
results.overview: A Tiliche dancer from Oaxaca loses his colorful fabrics in an attempt to assimilate into the unfamiliar, gray world that surrounds him.

results.title: With Hasan in Gaza
results.overview: Three MiniDV tapes of life in Gaza from 2001 were recently rediscovered. What started as a search for a former prison mate from 1989 led to an unexpected road trip from the north to the south of Gaza with Hasan, a local guide whose fate remains unknown.

results.title: Red Rocks
results.overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

results.title: Presidential 1776 Award: The Ultimate Civics Showdown
results.original_title: Presidential 1776 Award: The Ultimate Civics Showdown
results.overview: Hosted by Mario Lopez, The Presidential 1776 Award celebrates America’s brightest young civic scholars. After regional competitions nationwide, 20 finalists gather in Washington, D.C. for a fast-paced national championship. The field narrows to three finalists, who advance to a live, judged competition at the White House. With $250,000 in scholarships at stake, the event honors civic literacy, academic excellence, and national achievement.

results.title: National Sport
results.overview: As his girlfriend prepares to leave for Australia, a professional queuer who drifts through life without urgency finds it easier to share his fears with strangers in line than confront the end of his relationship, spending his final days suspended between waiting, regret, and the comfort of the present moment.

results.title: Without Looking Back
results.overview: A story about friendship and a crime that never happened. The main characters are Sonya and Zhenya. One day, they push a guy who was bothering them to the ground and, thinking they've killed him, go on the run.

results.title: I Killed Him in My Sleep
results.original_title: I Killed Him in My Sleep
results.overview: Millennial Kelty Crawford struggles with financial strain, career uncertainty, and a wedding she can't afford. Desperate for money, Crawford enrolls in a sleep-study experiment that spirals into terror when she experiences a vivid, violent dream of a dying man, a bloody knife in her hand, and a voice accusing her of murder.

results.title: Soy Luna Tour: The last show
results.original_title: Soy Luna Tour: El último show
results.overview: After ten years, the cast of Soy Luna returns to the stage with a live show featuring the series’ most iconic songs and tracks from the new season. Music, dance, and emotion come together in a celebration created to reconnect with fans.

results.title: P$RN STAR University
results.overview: What happens when one of OnlyFans’ biggest stars decides to open a university? Andy Lee is breaking taboos and building a business, one straight guy at a time. With fifteen years in the adult industry behind him, he’s now doing something nobody else has attempted: launching a real-life school for aspiring male performers, coaching, coaxing and filming straight-identifying men as they step into gay adult content for the first time. His new intake arrives with different motivations, quick cash, curiosity, ambition, or all three. What none of them expect is quite how much they’re about to learn, about performance, yes, but also about boundaries, identity and the surprisingly emotional experience of being truly seen.

results.title: The Birthday Party
results.overview: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.
